final_text:
These are the top 5 customers for account review, ranked by invoiced sales excluding tax.

**Source:** product DAILY_INVOICED_SALES, version 201, object `HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.L2P_RELEASE.DAILY_INVOICED_SALES_V0201`. It's a synthetic Northstar Supply dataset covering 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03, and the content hash matched when the ranking ran.

| Rank | Customer (ID) | Sales excl. tax | Invoice lines | Distinct items | Active days | First – last invoice |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Fictional Customer 010 (10) | 4,964.45 | 17 | 11 | 7 | 2026-01-05 – 2026-02-22 |
| 2 | Fictional Customer 008 (8) | 4,719.06 | 22 | 13 | 7 | 2026-01-11 – 2026-03-03 |
| 3 | Fictional Customer 019 (19) | 4,297.74 | 16 | 11 | 6 | 2026-01-08 – 2026-02-21 |
| 4 | Fictional Customer 018 (18) | 4,072.60 | 18 | 10 | 8 | 2026-01-08 – 2026-02-26 |
| 5 | Fictional Customer 004 (4) | 3,756.35 | 22 | 12 | 9 | 2026-01-06 – 2026-02-21 |

Sales excluding tax is the invoice price minus tax. The product doesn't record a currency, so the figures have no currency symbol.

**Notes:**
- The top two are close, about 245 apart. Customer 008 has the most recent invoice (2026-03-03) and the widest range of items.
- Customer 004 ranks fifth but was active on the most days (9) and is tied for the most invoice lines (22), so it buys more often, in smaller amounts.
- The data only covers about two months, ending in early March 2026. It doesn't show what these customers have done since.

**What this ranking can't tell you:** it's based only on invoiced sales. The product has no data on marketing consent, campaign responses, margin or campaign effects, and it doesn't include returns or discounts. So it can't show whether a customer may be contacted, whether they're profitable, or whether a campaign would change their buying. It only shows who bought the most in this period.
